validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Confirmed real and under construction. Independent of GEM. Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3) is a major, well-documented program (17 EPC packages, ~$10-25bn, contracts awarded 2024). Package 4 is specifically the EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 segment. CLASSIFICATION: Correctly a dry-gas TRANSMISSION trunk line (East-West Gas Pipeline of the Master Gas System), not NGL/gathering. DUPLICATE CHECK (vs roster): P6719 segment '..."3"' (150km, 56in) and P6720 (150km, 56in) are NOT a double-count. blackridgeresearch states: 'Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 (300km)' -- i.e. TWO parallel 56-inch lines, East-West Gas Pipeline 3 and 4, totaling 300km = 150km each. So P6719 = line 3 (EWGP-3), P6720 = line 4 (EWGP-4); both legitimate. SPEC: Diameter 56in -> CONFIRMED (multiple independent sources). Length 150km -> CONFIRMED by inference: independent sources agree the EWPS-1->EWPS-3 scope is 300km for two parallel lines, so 150km per line matches GEM exactly. Status 'construction' -> CONFIRMED (construction commenced Q2 2024, completion Q4 2028). Owner Aramco -> CONFIRMED. StartYear1 2028 -> consistent with sources giving Q4 2028 completion/start-up. ATTRIBUTION: endpoints EWPS-1 (East-West Pump Station 1) -> EWPS-3, Saudi Arabia, Eastern Province corridor -> consistent. CAVEAT: the 150km-per-line split is derived from the published 300km total for two lines rather than an explicit per-line figure in a single source; the existing MEED [ref] on the Length cell did not contain the literal '150' token (its scope figures are aggregate/300km).
